question:
Identify the figure from among the given options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2b2eed53ba96003af7c9a08e15febbde0761d4188066114e1ea60abde673e61.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) One shaded circle is eliminated from the bottom from each box subsequently.

2) One shaded circle is replaced alternately by element 'X' subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e40633f58246837d4a7533f76f3ff207d9c3460c7a1e83c8878c3e4af09d71f5.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0a20f0719c7cccfe5ed8e0ed189a31c3fc572a03810c9835d57f6a600b32d78.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
